result.notes: Free tier account (250 contacts) grants a self-serve API key immediately, and OAuth2 app registration is self-service via the Registered Apps page — no partner gate or app review found. Docs site surfaces a GraphQL signal on the developer homepage but the documented and primary public API is REST (Marketing API v3); no evidence of a fully separate public GraphQL API was found, so api_type is reported as rest. MCP is community-maintained only (cyanheads, asklokesh), no official vendor MCP server found.
